evidence.text: Which universal relations connect the mass gap m, gravitational cutoff Λ_QG, higher-derivative Wilson coefficients and vacuum energy V across low-energy string phases, and can these relations support holographic bounds or indirect phenomenology?

sources.title: On the vacuum entropy and the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can the holographic bound on vacuum fluctuation entropy explain the small positive cosmological constant through Zel’dovich’s relation, and why should its mass scale be the QCD transition scale?

sources.title: Holography and the Swampland: Constraints on Quantum Gravity from Holographic Principles

evidence.text: Can the Distance, de Sitter and Weak Gravity conjectures be unified as consequences of boundary spectral positivity, energy conditions, modular consistency and holographic information theory?

sources.title: A paucity of bulk entangling surfaces: AdS wormholes with de Sitter interiors

evidence.text: Can real holographic entangling surfaces exist in non-traversable AdS wormholes containing unbounded inflation, and what entropy prescription remains meaningful when expected extremal surfaces are absent?

sources.title: Holographic Inflation Revised

evidence.text: Can Holographic Space-Time provide an inflationary cosmology with long-lived localized excitations, explain its low-entropy initial conditions, and connect primordial fluctuations and reheating to a dilute black-hole gas?

sources.title: Census Taking in the Hat: FRW/CFT Duality

evidence.text: Can observations within a terminal, zero-cosmological-constant bubble be organized by a two-dimensional holographic theory, with Census Taker time represented through renormalization and a dynamical boundary geometry?

sources.title: Conditions for (No) Eternal Inflation

evidence.text: Can holographic observables and consistent asymptotic descriptions accommodate eternally inflating regions?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Can entanglement entropy in DS/dS constrain the matter content of de Sitter quantum gravity? The thesis proposes such a criterion to investigate qualitative swampland claims within a specified holographic framework.

sources.title: How to have your wormholes and factorize, too

evidence.text: Can a modified semiclassical holographic dictionary support a factorizing gravitational path integral, a single-state von Neumann entropy with a Page curve, and nontrivial closed-universe states within one framework?

sources.title: Brane gases in the early universe: Thermodynamics and cosmology

evidence.text: Can early-universe M2-brane thermodynamics, creation and annihilation leave winding relics that select three decompactifying dimensions, when initial states are sampled statistically and constrained by holography?

sources.title: One-loop effect of null-like cosmology's holographic dual super-Yang-Mills

evidence.text: Does the holographic SYM dual of a null-like cosmology retain boson–fermion cancellation of one-loop vacuum energy for arbitrary null-dependent BPS scalar profiles, and what does this indicate about particle production, ultraviolet behavior and the bulk singularity?

sources.title: Bekenstein bound, holography and brane cosmology in charged black hole background

evidence.text: How does electric charge modify entropy bounds in D≥4, and can charged AdS holography connect these bounds to brane FRW cosmology in both BDL and moving-domain-wall descriptions?

sources.title: A Holographic framework for eternal inflation

evidence.text: Can Coleman-De Luccia decay of four-dimensional de Sitter space into an asymptotically flat bubble admit a two-dimensional Euclidean holographic description, with time emerging through a boundary Wheeler-DeWitt theory? sources.title: Of bounces, branes and bounds

evidence.text: Can charged-bulk brane bounce cosmologies containing negative-energy stiff matter satisfy the causal entropy bound, despite an earlier holographic c-theorem argument against their viability?

sources.title: Holography in general space-times

evidence.text: Can a covariant, background-independent holographic principle identify screens storing the information of general spacetimes, and what do their geometry and changing area imply for possible holographic theories?

sources.title: Holography and cosmology

evidence.text: How should the holographic entropy bound be formulated in cosmology, and what conditional restrictions would it impose on expansion, the equation of state, and spatial curvature?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity as Gravitized Quantum Theory

evidence.text: Can phase-space regularization combined with holography motivate quantum gravity as quantum theory with dynamical state-space geometry and topology, and connect vacuum energy, experimental interference signatures, and particle mass hierarchies?

sources.title: Quantum Transitions Between Minkowski and de Sitter Spacetimes

evidence.text: Can bubble nucleation connect Minkowski and de Sitter configurations within Hamiltonian quantum gravity, consistently with detailed balance and holographic purity arguments?

destination.title: Causal access, chronology and temporal orientation
destination.question: How do global causal structure, temporal orientation and boundary-theory independence constrain observable propagation and proposed spacetime constructions?
destination.summary: This card connects classical censorship, chronology questions and orientation-dependent quantum constructions while preserving their different premises.

Analogue systems as a comparison setting
